summary.zh: 把文章、论文或书籍整理进可持续维护的知识库
summary.en: Keep an Obsidian knowledge base current as sources come in

description.zh: 把论文、文章或书籍整理进 Obsidian 知识库，维护索引、链接和条目格式，并定期检查断链与重复。适合长期维护第二大脑、需要持续消化外部资料，或知识库越写越乱时使用。需要一个 Obsidian 库目录，整理脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Ingests papers, articles and books into an Obsidian vault, keeping the index, links and entry format in shape and flagging broken links over time. Use it for a long-lived second brain. Needs a vault directory and local Python.
